input: Look into freelance writing gigs online

gold.taskTitle: Find and Pursue Freelance Writing Gigs Online
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify online freelance writing opportunities that match the user's background, goals, and preferences.

questions.title: What type of writing do you want to do?
questions.description: Identify the specific writing niche or format the user is interested in, such as blog posts, copywriting, technical writing, journalism, or creative writing.

questions.title: What is your current level of writing experience?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is a complete beginner, has some informal experience, or has professional writing credentials.

questions.title: Which platforms have you already looked at?
questions.description: Find out if the user has already explored platforms like Upwork, Fiverr, or ProBlogger, to avoid redundant suggestions.

questions.title: What is your income goal from freelance writing?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a side income, a part-time supplement, or a full-time living from freelance writing.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you dedicate?
questions.description: Understand the user's available time to shape realistic goals and a workload plan.

questions.title: Do you have writing samples or a portfolio ready?
questions.description: Determine if the user has existing work to show clients, or if building a portfolio is part of what needs to be done.

questions.title: Are there topics or industries you want to focus on?
questions.description: Identify subject matter areas the user is knowledgeable or passionate about, such as tech, health, finance, or travel.
